title: Request for Comments on Community Outreach Office Locations in the Southwest States
summary_finding: This notice seeks public comments regarding the physical locations of federal community outreach offices across southwest states. It imposes no regulatory obligations, technical standards, or reporting duties on AI operators.

title: Hematology and Pathology Devices; Reclassification of In Situ Hybridization Test Systems for Use With a Corresponding Approved Oncology Therapeutic Product
summary_finding: The FDA has reclassified in situ hybridization test systems from Class III (premarket approval) to Class II (special controls). This alters device classification pathways for pathology diagnostic systems but creates no broad AI developer obligations.
actionable_trigger: Monitor special controls compliance criteria if deploying automated ISH digital pathology diagnostic algorithms.

title: Unified Agenda of Federal Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions-2026
summary_finding: This publication provides the semiannual compendium of planned federal agency regulatory and deregulatory actions across the executive branch. It represents an administrative forecasting schedule and establishes no binding legal duties for private operators.
actionable_trigger: Filter and extract specific AI agency rulemaking entries from individual cabinet departments when notices of proposed rulemaking appear.

title: Introduction to the Unified Agenda of Federal Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions-2026
summary_finding: This document is the general introductory overview to the 2026 Unified Agenda prepared by the Regulatory Information Service Center and OIRA. It explains cross-agency publication procedures without creating any substantive legal or technical mandates.
actionable_trigger: No action required; archive alongside main agenda index.

title: FCC To Review E-Rate Program To Ensure Congress's Vision
summary_finding: The Federal Communications Commission announces a review of the E-Rate universal service support mechanism for schools and libraries. It does not impose operational AI safety, transparency, or model governance mandates.

title: Airworthiness Directives; The Boeing Company Airplanes
summary_finding: The Federal Aviation Administration issues a mandatory airworthiness directive addressing structural or mechanical inspection requirements on Boeing aircraft. The directive contains no provisions governing artificial intelligence models or algorithmic systems.

title: Renewal of the Innovation Advisory Committee
summary_finding: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission renews the charter of its Innovation Advisory Committee to advise on emerging technologies including algorithmic trading and automated financial systems. The charter renewal is an internal administrative action creating no immediate private operator duties.
actionable_trigger: Track advisory committee agenda items and working group publications regarding automated algorithmic trading risks.

title: Request for Information (RFI) on Modernizing the National Vulnerability Database in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
summary_finding: The National Institute of Standards and Technology issues a Request for Information seeking public input on updating the National Vulnerability Database to track AI software flaws and automated exploit risks. This consultation represents voluntary technical information gathering without establishing mandatory operator duties.
actionable_trigger: Submit comments on AI vulnerability classification schemes before the public consultation deadline.

title: Adjusting Imports of Polysilicon and Its Derivatives Into the United States
summary_finding: Presidential proclamation adjusting tariff and import regimes on polysilicon derivatives under national security trade authorities. It affects upstream semiconductor manufacturing supply chains but creates no AI software or operator compliance duties.

title: Innovation Advisory Committee

title: Continuation of the National Emergency With Respect to Export Control Regulations
statutory_reference: 50 U.S.C. 1701 et seq.; 50 U.S.C. 1622(d); Executive Order 13222
summary_finding: Presidential notice continuing for one year the national emergency declared in Executive Order 13222, maintaining the statutory basis for the Export Administration Regulations. This continuation preserves the existing export control regime without imposing novel AI model compliance mandates.
actionable_trigger: Verify ongoing compliance with existing Bureau of Industry and Security dual-use export classifications.

title: Continuation of the National Emergency With Respect to the Advancement by Countries of Concern in Sensitive Technologies and Products Critical for the Military, Intelligence, Surveillance, or Cyber-Enabled Capabilities of Such Countries
statutory_reference: Executive Order 14105; 50 U.S.C. 1701 et seq.; 31 CFR Part 850
summary_finding: This presidential notice extends the national emergency under Executive Order 14105, which enforces binding outbound investment prohibitions and mandatory Treasury notification duties for US persons financing frontier AI systems in designated countries of concern. It maintains active compliance burdens for cross-border AI capital transactions.
actionable_trigger: Ensure legal audit of outbound AI capital transfers and technology licensing partnerships under Treasury 31 CFR Part 850 rules.

title: Request for regulators to publish an update on their strategic approach to AI: Secretary of State letters
statutory_reference: UK AI White Paper (CP 815); DSIT Ministerial Direction
summary_finding: The UK Secretary of State requests designated sectoral regulators, including Ofgem and the CMA, to publish strategic roadmaps outlining their regulatory approach to AI. This directive binds public regulators rather than private operators directly, but signals imminent sectoral guidance updates across regulated utilities.
actionable_trigger: Review forthcoming Ofgem and sectoral regulator strategic response papers for emergent compliance expectations.
